verdict.rationale: Bruno's official docs state you can 'Write assertions and test suites, and automate runs with data-driven testing' and generate JSON/JUnit/HTML test reports, confirming built-in test/assertion functionality against API responses. However, the evidence never explicitly breaks down assertions by status code, body, and headers separately. missing for 10: explicit doc examples of status-code/body/header assertion syntax, independent hands-on confirmation of assertion granularity.
